answer: A datacenter or proxy pool as a result cannot mint a army of identities in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, because each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The ripple cap is enforced at intake and kernel shows the per-origin counts. At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a orchard tag. That is 23 dollars per alias.
